data.goal: Measure whether the federal IT PSC codes (DA01, DA10, 7A21, 7030, D304) are enterable: what fraction of each code's FY2023 recipients had no award in that code in the prior window, with gates declared before any fetch

$ python3 EXPERIMENTS/E209-it-code-entrant-share/controls.py
$ python3 EXPERIMENTS/E209-it-code-entrant-share/analyze.py

federal IT PSC codes are not uniformly enterable: median segment-newcomer fraction 0.2677 < declared 0.30 kill gate; DA01/DA10/7A21 enterable at 0.27-0.31, 7030/D304 exactly 0.0 (closed shops with heavy incumbent churn); fragmentation does not predict entry (rho +0.6669, n=5)

The uniform 'fragmented => a small program can enter' reading is unsupported in both domains measured (NIH SBIR E208, federal IT E209); a money-axis screen must select by measured entry, not fragmentation, and entry is bimodal across the five IT codes
